CLAIM 2 [CONFIRMED]: OG:IMAGE PER PAGE — 108 pages have og:image meta, 30 MISSING. Of 108: 25 use og-default.png (category, pagination, 3 no-hero articles), 83 use per-page article-specific images. 30 missing are no-hero article pages + 7 category/pagination page/1 instances.

CLAIM 3 [REFUTED]: 9 GENERIC UTILITY-*.JPG SHARED ACROSS 45 ARTICLES — Zero remain. `find . -name 'utility-*.jpg'` returns empty. All were replaced in Aug 15 Cycle 3 (commit deca1949). The IMAGE_AUDIT_REPORT.md table describing these is now stale.

CLAIM 4 [UNVERIFIED]: IMAGE_AUDIT_REPORT.MD RECONCILIATION — Report claims 102 files/10.2MB, 91 heroes. CURRENT: 200 files/21MB (due to Cycles 2-4 additions: 6 Bill Anatomy illustrations, 2 process graphics, 66 hero replacements). Heroes: 82 hero-img instances vs claimed 91 — the gap may be from redirected/absorbed articles. Cannot verify original 91-article list.

CLAIM 5 [CONFIRMED]: ACCESSIBILITY — Alt="" (empty string): 0. Descriptive alt on heroes: 82. **246 card images have `alt class=card-image`** — alt attribute present but no value (HTML spec: treated as missing alt, fails WCAG 1.1.1). These are related-articles card thumbnails. 96 card images have category-label alt text (`alt="Blog"`, etc.). All hero imgs: loading=eager, fetchpriority=high, decoding=async. All non-hero: loading=lazy, decoding=async.

CLAIM 6 [CONFIRMED]: PRIORITY PAGES WITH ONLY GENERIC STOCK — 0 of 26 priority pages rely on generic stock. 23 have article-specific heroes and per-page og:image. 3 have NO hero (ccf-calculator, which-rate-plan-is-right-for-me, gadgets-that-lower-utility-bills) and use og-default.png.
